title: EvidenceSelector
description: Identifies a fragment within an evidence unit. A selector REFINES an evidence location; it does NOT create a new source state. Selector types are open and profile-extensible: character offsets, XPath-like paths, JSON Pointers, field names, canonical fragment identifiers, event identifiers, page/paragraph coordinates, or a custom profile selector. The `type` discriminates; remaining fields depend on the type.

type.description: The selector type. Recognized base types include: textPosition, xpath, jsonPointer, fieldName, fragmentId, eventId, pageParagraph, custom.

expression.description: Path expression (for xpath / jsonPointer / fieldName selectors).

value.description: Literal selector value (for fragmentId / eventId / custom selectors).
